description: Look up building permit history and status for any King County, WA property. Accepts a street address, 10-digit parcel number, or permit number. Live sources: MyBuildingPermit (14 cities + unincorporated King County), Seattle and Bellevue open data, Renton EnerGov, Redmond Civic Access, Shoreline eTRAKiT, Woodinville + King County Accela, Normandy Park and Carnation SmartGov, SeaTac LAMA, WA State L&I (electrical), plus the King County Assessor's issued-permit index for every parcel (covers the 19 cities without a public portal; history only, no status). Jurisdiction is derived from the city-limits polygon, not the mailing city. Returns all matching permits sorted newest-first. Use for due diligence, permit tracking, or verifying contractor pull history.

inputSchema.description: Give `query` (address / parcel / permit number) OR `contractor` / `license` for a contractor pull-history search; never both.

contractor.description: Contractor company name (substring) — returns what they have pulled across the MyBuildingPermit cities. Use instead of query.

license.description: WA L&I contractor license number — same search by license. Use instead of query.

limit.description: Max permits to return (newest first). summary always covers the whole matched set, so start small and raise only if you need the rows.

query.description: One of: street address ('1817 Morris Ave S, Renton WA 98055'), 10-digit parcel number (plain '7222000353' or formatted '722200-0353'), or permit number ('B25000947', 'ADDC21-0275', '23-127651-LP', '6145915-CN'). Input type is auto-detected.

since.description: Only permits applied/issued on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

types.description: Case-insensitive substrings matched against each permit's type, e.g. ['electrical', 'mechanical'].

name: king_county_permit_status

action.description: found — permits[] is populated; none — no permits found; refine — connection issue, retry; reject — bad input

address_resolution.description: How well the geocoder matched an address query. match_type: point (exact address point), interpolated (number placed along the street; no parcel), street (street only). partial_match is true for anything but point; street_number_snapped when the matched house number differs from the one given.

candidate_parcels.description: Present when several parcels sit within 40 ft of an interpolated point; the first was used

parcel_basis.description: How the parcel was found: the locator's address point; the parcel polygon under an interpolated point; or the nearest parcel within 40 ft (check candidate_parcels)

cite_as.description: One-line attribution string for generated text

coverage_note.description: Contractor searches only: which cities were (and were not) searched

errors.description: Source errors when a search is incomplete; may accompany permits from sources that succeeded.

fetched_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of this query; records are live, not cached

filters.description: The limit/since/types that produced this response

jurisdiction.description: Which authority the query was routed to and why. basis: city-limits (geocoded point inside the city's polygon — authoritative), geocoder-city (locator's city, outside King County's polygon layer), address-text (the mailing city in the query), parcel-site-address (a parcel query, resolved through the Assessor's site address), null (none). unincorporated=true means county permits only.

next_step.description: Structured twin of separate_portal: the exact follow-up an agent can take. kind=manual_portal_search; reason in no_feed|electrical_only|parcel_resolution_failed|source_incomplete; portal_url (the portal's search page when known); vendor; search_by (inputs that page accepts, empty when login-gated); query/query_type to re-use; covers_electrical; hint.

parcel_id.description: County-namespaced parcel id, e.g. 'king:7222000353' or 'pierce:5985002900', when the query was or resolved to a parcel

permit_count.description: Unique permits found before any since/types filter (= summary.total)

permits.description: Up to `limit` permit records, newest first (applied_date, else issued_date).

is_open.description: Heuristic, census-tested weekly: false when finaled/closed/expired/withdrawn/etc. (or a finaled_date exists), true for issued/pending/review words, null when the source exposes no status. Check is_open_basis before relying on it.

is_open_basis.description: finaled_date = certain (the record carries a final date); status-vocabulary = regex over the vendor's status word (heuristic); null = no status available

portal.description: Source permit or portal URL when available

record_url.description: URL of this specific permit record when the source exposes one; null when portal is only a search page

status.description: e.g. Issued, Complete, On Hold, Withdrawn, Expired

routing_by_type.description: Per permit type (building, mechanical_plumbing, electrical, land_use, engineering_row, fire, grading, septic) for the resolved jurisdiction: {system, portal, live, note}. live=true means that system is searched by this tool; otherwise the portal is where to look. Present for address queries and parcel queries that resolved a city.

separate_portal.description: Present when manual follow-up at a city portal is needed, including when a live city search is incomplete. Includes city, portal URL, note.

summary.description: Computed over every permit matching since/types (not just the returned rows): total, matched, returned, truncated, open, closed, status_unknown, open_basis_counts {finaled_date, status-vocabulary} (how many open/closed verdicts rest on a fact vs the status-word heuristic), by_type, by_status, by_year, years [oldest, newest], latest {permit_number,type,status,date,jurisdiction}. Answer from this; drill into permits only when you need rows.

trust_level.description: live — every applicable source answered; partial — a source errored or hit its result cap (see errors); fallback — nothing searchable, use next_step. A city needing manual follow-up (next_step) does not by itself lower trust.

title: King County permit status
